title: Lava Release
body:
Lava Release forms from Earth + Fire. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Molten Pebbles (help molten pebbles)
Level 45: Lava Snare (help lava snare)
Level 70: Magma Torrent (help magma torrent)
